SELECT A.FINPROD_ID BOOKID, A.FINPROD_ID AS FINPRODID, P.FINPROD_NAME AS FINPRODABBR, date_format(A.VAL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS VALDATE, CASE P.PROFIT_TYPE WHEN '03'THEN 1 ELSE ifnull(A.NET_UNIT_VALUE, 0) END AS ASSETVALUE, ifnull(A.NET_UNIT_VALUE, 0) AS NETUNITVALUE, ifnull(A.SEVEN_DAY_RATE, 0) AS SEVENDAYRATE, '365' BASIS, ifnull(A.PAY_PROFIT,0) payProfit, ext.PARAM_VALUE profitTypeCode FROM BOK_VALBAL_TABLE_STATUS A LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT P ON A.FINPROD_ID = P.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_EXT ext ON A.FINPROD_ID = ext.BOOKSET_ID AND ext.PARAM_CODE = 'PROFIT_TYPE' WHERE 1 = 1 AND NOTICE_STATUS=1
AND A.VAL_DATE =STR_TO_DATE(#{valDate},'%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT A.FINPROD_ID BOOKID, A.FINPROD_ID AS FINPRODID, P.FINPROD_NAME AS FINPRODABBR, date_format(A.VAL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS VALDATE, CASE P.PROFIT_TYPE WHEN '03'THEN 1 ELSE ifnull(A.NET_UNIT_VALUE, 0) END AS ASSETVALUE, ifnull(A.NET_UNIT_VALUE, 0) AS NETUNITVALUE, ifnull(A.SEVEN_DAY_RATE, 0) AS SEVENDAYRATE, '365' BASIS, ifnull(A.PAY_PROFIT,0) payProfit, ext.PARAM_VALUE profitTypeCode,
ifnull(bvtd.MARKET_VALUE,0) prdTotAssetVal, ifnull(bvtd.MARKET_VALUE,0)-ifnull(bvtd1.MARKET_VALUE,0) prdAssetVal
FROM BOK_VALBAL_TABLE_STATUS A LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT P ON A.FINPROD_ID = P.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_EXT ext ON A.FINPROD_ID = ext.BOOKSET_ID AND ext.PARAM_CODE = 'PROFIT_TYPE'
left join BOK_VAL_TABLE_DATA bvtd on bvtd.BOOKSET_ID = A.FINPROD_ID and bvtd.VAL_DATE = A.VAL_DATE and bvtd.DETAIL_DIST = '05' left join BOK_VAL_TABLE_DATA bvtd1 on bvtd1.BOOKSET_ID = A.FINPROD_ID and bvtd1.VAL_DATE = A.VAL_DATE and bvtd1.DETAIL_DIST = '06'
WHERE NOTICE_STATUS=1
AND A.VAL_DATE =STR_TO_DATE(#{valDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
